title: 가울테리아 Perenual 병해충 청크
text:
[가울테리아 Perenual 진단 & 증상 가이드]
- 대상 식물: 가울테리아, Gaultheria
- 병해충 질환명: 가울테리아 Root Rot, Leaf Spot & Mealybug / Spider Mite Complex
- 주요 진단 증상: [가울테리아 Indoor Protection Guide]
Pests: Mealybugs, Spider Mites, Root Rot (Pythium/Rhizoctonia)
Symptoms: Yellow drooping leaves, cottony white clusters at leaf axils, fine silk webbing under leaves.
Control: Dab bugs with 70% Isopropyl alcohol. Spray 1-2% Cold-Pressed Neem Oil solution.
- 발병 태그: mushy_root_base, cottony_white_mealybugs, spider_mite_webbing, neem_oil

title: 가지 Perenual 병해충 청크
text:
[가지 Perenual 진단 & 증상 가이드]
- 대상 식물: 가지, Eggplant
- 병해충 질환명: 가지 Early Blight, Late Blight & Flea Beetle Infestation
- 주요 진단 증상: [가지 Disease & Pest Guide]
Pathogen: Alternaria solani & Phytophthora infestans
Symptoms: Concentric brown target-like leaf spots, water-soaked foliage collapse, and flea beetle foliage damage.
Control: Apply Copper Octanoate or Chlorothalonil every 7-10 days. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis for caterpillars.
- 발병 태그: target_spot_lesions, leaf_yellowing, flea_beetle_shot_holes, copper_fungicide

title: 감 Perenual 병해충 청크

- 주요 진단 증상: [감 Orchard Care Guide]
Pathogen: Venturia / Monilinia species & Cydia pomonella
Symptoms: Dark corky scabs on fruits/leaves, rapid soft fruit rot with beige spore rings.
Control: Apply Liquid Copper Fungicide at pink bud stage. Hang codling moth traps.
- 발병 태그: dark_fruit_scabs, brown_mummified_rot, codling_moth_holes, copper_soap
